name: Quagga & zebra mussels
desc: Invasive filter feeders that strip plankton from the water and clear it. They are now the main drain on the lake's food supply.
about: The quagga mussel is a species of freshwater mussel, an aquatic bivalve mollusc in the family Dreissenidae. It has a lifespan of 3 to 5 years.
